The nature of not feeling loathing for (the loathsome Kāyaduccarita), the nature of not being ashamed of (disgusting Kāyaduccarita). no shame- no disgust. (This Ahirika has the characteristic of not feeling loathing for Kāyaduccarita, etc. in other word, the characteristic of shamelessness (Alajjālakkhaṇā). Just as the pig of the villagers is not disgusted by excrement bog, Ahirika (shameless person) has the nature of not being shameful in and not being disgusted by doing Duccarita.
